# src/apexcrew/application/runtime.py
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, contextmanager

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RuntimeOwner:
    owner_id: RuntimeOwnerId


class RunOwnership(Protocol):
    def acquire(
        self, run_id: RunId
    ) -> AbstractContextManager[RuntimeOwner | None]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class FileLockBackend(Protocol):
    def try_lock(self, path: Path) -> AbstractContextManager[bool]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class RuntimeOwnerIdSource(Protocol):
    def next_runtime_owner_id(self) -> RuntimeOwnerId:
        raise NotImplementedError


class FileRunOwnership(RunOwnership):
    def __init__(self, data_root: Path, locks: FileLockBackend, ids: RuntimeOwnerIdSource) -> None:
        self._data_root = data_root
        self._locks = locks
        self._ids = ids

    @contextmanager
    def acquire(self, run_id: RunId) -> Iterator[RuntimeOwner | None]:
        path = self._data_root / "runtime-locks" / f"{run_id}.lock"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self._locks.try_lock(path) as locked:
            yield RuntimeOwner(self._ids.next_runtime_owner_id()) if locked else None


class InMemoryRunOwnership(RunOwnership):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._held: set[RunId] = set()
        self._next = 0

    @contextmanager
    def acquire(self, run_id: RunId) -> Iterator[RuntimeOwner | None]:
        if run_id in self._held:
            yield None
            return
        self._held.add(run_id)
        self._next += 1
        try:
            yield RuntimeOwner(RuntimeOwnerId(f"memory-owner-{self._next}"))
        finally:
            self._held.remove(run_id)
```

Persist a Permit with source command ID/digest, generation, issued sequence, allowed starting phase, complete applicable revision snapshot, target-authority digest, and expected runtime-progress generation. Consume it, install the owner ID, increment progress, and open the owned-time interval in one expected-sequence transaction before recovery. `permit_allows_state` is a pure runtime predicate: every ordinary Permit remains phase-exact; a `DRAFT` Permit accepts `DRAFT` initially and may accept `PLANNING` only after this same call observed `TARGET_RESERVATION_INITIALIZED`; a `READY_TO_START` Permit similarly accepts `ACTIVE` only after `PRIVATE_REF_INITIALIZED`. `RuntimeService` invokes it before every loop iteration, so a local witness cannot lend a Permit to an orphaned or later phase. On an initially `DRAFT` Run, the runtime invokes only `initialize_target_reservation` before journal recovery, generic reconciliation, Coordinator scheduling, or any model boundary. Its `CONTINUE` result is valid only with the named phase-transition witness and a strictly advanced Audit sequence. A conflict leaves the Run `DRAFT`; an unobservable observation or outcome enters the durable `INDETERMINATE` path; neither reaches a provider call. Every normal `run_until_blocked` return calls the one `record_runtime_delivery_stop` transaction while the file lock is still held; only an injected/real process termination leaves a reclaimable owner and open interval.

The concrete observer is closed and adapter-owned. `GitTargetReservationRepository.observe_registration(reservation)` runs only `git worktree list --porcelain -z` through Task 7's bound `GitCommandRunner` and parses bounded NUL-delimited records. It accepts a target only when the one registration at the persisted reservation path is the sole registration for the target ref, is locked as required, holds the pinned OID, and the only second record is the already-safe main worktree. A target registration at another path, including a checked-out main-worktree target, is a third state, never absence. A command failure, malformed record, extra record, or unreadable/reparse path is explicitly unobservable or non-exact; it cannot trigger add or lock. `ReservationPathInspector.observe_path(reservation)` opens the preallocated reservation path relative to the canonical private data root with Task 7's no-follow handle tree and compares its single `.git` file byte-for-byte with the expected owned Git admin back-reference. `TargetReservationObservationService` combines those results with the lock bit into Task 8's `ReservationObservation`. Thus only an exact absence can reach typed add, only a fresh exact registered-unlocked observation can reach typed lock, and no model request occurs until atomic settlement has moved the Run to `PLANNING`.

After the DRAFT bridge, `next_recovered_model_action` runs first: it returns the oldest durable `RECOVERED_MODEL_ACTION` marker and routes it to the owning phase driver, never to generic recovery. `next_recoverable_model_turn` then returns the oldest exact Run-owned `COMPLETION_COMMITTED` turn with no downstream intent, ordered by logical-turn creation sequence; both state adapters implement the same query. After ordinary effect reconciliation, compare its persisted request binding with the currently frozen revision digests and tool-schema digest, recover through Task 4B without calling `ModelPort`, construct `RecoveredModelAction`, and atomically record its opaque downstream `EffectIntent` before schema parsing or any phase dispatch. A phase driver either (a) atomically settles that marker with its next durable planning/worker state transition, or (b) returns a recorded stop while leaving the same marker for exact permit-gated re-entry; it may never discard or replace it. Already-journaled recovery work is allowed to settle even if owned time reached 100 percent during that work, then the post-action boundary records the Budget stop. Every not-yet-journaled target-reservation, planning, private-ref, Worker, resolution, integration, or cleanup action passes a pre-boundary check and a post-settlement check owned by `RuntimeService`. Only when no journaled marker or committed completion exists and the pre-check remains below 100 percent may Coordinator or WorkerLoop schedule work or request another model completion. A binding mismatch or already-recorded downstream intent closes new dispatch and returns the exact recovery stop instead of skipping ahead.

Let exact pause/cancel append an interrupt request while a runtime is active, close new dispatch immediately, let journaled in-flight intents settle, and apply the interrupt only after that barrier. At the same barrier, apply any Task 10 pending Budget/Model Configuration replacement or Task 9B `BUDGET_STOP_REQUESTED` after its triggering action settlement and before recovery or new dispatch; interrupt precedence still wins, replacement never creates a new effect under the consumed source Permit, and a budget stop records the exact affected Task/Run, reason, and preserved counters.

An identical source-command replay may perform delivery composition only while its exact Permit remains unconsumed and no later control/runtime progress exists. Once consumed, return its committed `CommandOutcome` without minting or invoking another Permit; a different `continue` during the delivery crash window returns `CONFLICT/RUNTIME_DELIVERY_PENDING`.

@dataclass
class ManualMonotonicClock:
    nanoseconds: int

    @classmethod
    def at_seconds(cls, seconds: int) -> "ManualMonotonicClock":
        return cls(seconds * 1_000_000_000)

    def now(self) -> MonotonicInstant:
        return MonotonicInstant(self.nanoseconds)

    def advance_seconds(self, seconds: int) -> None:
        if seconds < 0:
            raise ValueError("MANUAL_MONOTONIC_ADVANCE_NEGATIVE")
        self.nanoseconds += seconds * 1_000_000_000


@dataclass
class RegressOnceMonotonicClock:
    first: MonotonicInstant
    regressed: MonotonicInstant
    calls: int = 0

    def now(self) -> MonotonicInstant:
        self.calls += 1
        return self.regressed if self.calls == 2 else self.first

        run_id=RunId("run-task-warning"),
        task_ceiling=12,
    )
    warning = valid_plan_proposal(
        run_id=RunId("run-task-warning"), task_count=10,
        planning_request_count=1,
    )
    warning_store.persist_plan_proposal(
        warning, expected_sequence=warning_store.audit_sequence(warning.run_id)
    )
    assert warning_store.global_usage_snapshot(warning.run_id).tasks == 10
    assert warning_store.budget_warnings(
        warning.run_id, GlobalBudgetMetric.TASKS
    )[0].used == 10
    assert warning_store.run_record(warning.run_id).state == (
        RunState.AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL
    )

    stop_store = seeded_planning_store(
        tmp_path / "task-stop.db",
        run_id=RunId("run-task-stop"),
        task_ceiling=12,
    )
    at_ceiling = valid_plan_proposal(
        run_id=RunId("run-task-stop"), task_count=12,
        planning_request_count=1,
    )
    stop_store.persist_plan_proposal(
        at_ceiling,
        expected_sequence=stop_store.audit_sequence(at_ceiling.run_id),
    )
    assert stop_store.plan_proposal(
        at_ceiling.run_id, at_ceiling.plan_digest
    ) == at_ceiling
    assert stop_store.global_usage_snapshot(at_ceiling.run_id).tasks == 12
    assert stop_store.run_record(at_ceiling.run_id).state == RunState.PAUSED
    assert stop_store.new_dispatch_open(at_ceiling.run_id) is False
    assert stop_store.audit_event_kinds(at_ceiling.run_id)[-2:] == (
        "PLAN_PROPOSED", "BUDGET_STOP_REQUESTED"
    )

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import subprocess
from typing import cast

import pytest

from apexcrew.adapters.repository.planning import (
    GitPlanningSnapshotReader,
    PlanningReadDenied,
)
from apexcrew.adapters.repository.git import RepositoryInstance
from apexcrew.domain.coordination import PlanningTurnBinding
from apexcrew.domain.plan import CanonicalPath
from apexcrew.domain.revisions import (
    HardDeniedPathClass,
    PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument,
)
from apexcrew.domain.types import GitOid, RepositoryId


@dataclass
class ScriptedBytesRunner:
    output: bytes
    calls: list[tuple[str, ...]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def run_bytes(
        self, repository: RepositoryInstance, argv: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        del repository
        self.calls.append(argv)
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, self.output, b"")


class AllowingPlanningPathGate:
    def require_allowed(
        self, path: CanonicalPath, authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument
    ) -> None:
        del path, authorization

    def require_manifest_allowed(
        self, path: CanonicalPath, binding: PlanningTurnBinding
    ) -> None:
        del path, binding


def planning_read_authorization() -> PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument:
    return PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument(
        matcher_version="apexcrew-path-v1",
        positive_globs=("src/**",),
        hard_denied_path_classes=tuple(HardDeniedPathClass),
    )


def test_snapshot_reader_rejects_nonregular_tree_entry_before_blob_read() -> None:
    base = GitOid("1" * 40)
    runner = ScriptedBytesRunner(b"120000 blob " + b"2" * 40 + b"\tsrc/link\0")
    reader = GitPlanningSnapshotReader(
        cast(RepositoryInstance, object()), RepositoryId("repository-1"),
        runner, AllowingPlanningPathGate(),
    )
    with pytest.raises(PlanningReadDenied, match="TRACKED_REGULAR_FILE_REQUIRED"):
        reader.read_tracked_file(
            base, CanonicalPath.parse("src/link"), planning_read_authorization(),
        )
    assert runner.calls == [("ls-tree", "-z", str(base), "--", "src/link")]


def test_worker_action_is_invalid_without_opening_a_planning_read_gateway() -> None:
    gateway = RecordingPlanningReadGateway()
    coordinator = make_planning_coordinator(actions=({"kind": "patch", "path": "src/a.py"},), gateway=gateway)
    decision = coordinator.run_planning_turn(RunId("run-plan"))
    assert decision.code == "MALFORMED_ACTION"
    assert gateway.call_count == 0


def test_planning_read_records_and_settles_one_bounded_effect() -> None:
    gateway = RecordingPlanningReadGateway(payload={"content": "x", "truncated": False})
    coordinator = make_planning_coordinator(
        actions=({"kind": "read_tracked_file", "path": "src/a.py"},), gateway=gateway,
    )
    decision = coordinator.run_planning_turn(RunId("run-plan"))
    assert decision.code == "CONTINUE"
    assert gateway.call_count == 1
    assert coordinator.store.effect_intent_count(RunId("run-plan")) == 1
    assert coordinator.store.effect_result_count(RunId("run-plan")) == 1


def test_recovered_planning_action_settles_marker_without_model_call() -> None:
    coordinator, model = make_recovered_planning_coordinator({"kind": "fail", "reason": "blocked"})
    decision = coordinator.resume_recovered_planning_action(
        RunId("run-plan"), consumed_planning_permit(), recovered_planning_action(),
    )
    assert decision.stop_reason == "PLANNING_FAILED"
    assert model.call_count == 0
    assert coordinator.store.unsettled_recovered_marker_count(RunId("run-plan")) == 0

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PlanProposal:
    run_id: RunId
    plan_digest: RevisionDigest
    canonical_plan_json: str
    plan: PlanRevision
    base_run_head_oid: GitOid
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests
    run_check_set: tuple[CheckDefinition, ...]
    dependency_edges: tuple[tuple[TaskId, TaskId], ...]
    hazard_edges: tuple[tuple[TaskId, TaskId], ...]
    planning_request_count: int

    @classmethod
    def from_validated_plan(
        cls,
        *,
        run_id: RunId,
        canonical_plan_json: str,
        plan: PlanRevision,
        base_run_head_oid: GitOid,
        applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests,
        run_check_set: tuple[CheckDefinition, ...],
        planning_request_count: int,
    ) -> "PlanProposal":
        if not 1 <= planning_request_count <= 8:
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_REQUEST_COUNT_INVALID")
        validation = validate_plan(plan)
        dependencies = tuple(
            sorted(
                (dependency, task.task_id)
                for task in plan.tasks
                for dependency in task.dependency_task_ids
            )
        )
        hazards = tuple(sorted(validation.promotion_hazards))
        return cls(
            run_id=run_id,
            plan_digest=RevisionDigest(sha256_digest(canonical_plan_json)),
            canonical_plan_json=canonical_plan_json,
            plan=plan,
            base_run_head_oid=base_run_head_oid,
            applicable_revision_digests=applicable_revision_digests,
            run_check_set=run_check_set,
            dependency_edges=dependencies,
            hazard_edges=hazards,
            planning_request_count=planning_request_count,
        )
```

Both adapters implement `persist_plan_proposal`, `plan_proposal`, `task_contracts`, `task_dependency_edges`, `hazard_edges`, `run_check_set`, `planning_request_count`, `planning_returned_bytes`, and `settle_planning_read(...) -> PlanningReadSettlement`. `persist_plan_proposal` re-reads the current approved Budget and rejects more Tasks than its `task_ceiling` (whose schema maximum is 12), then validates acyclicity, exact edge endpoints, unique IDs/digests, all revision/base bindings, request count, and complete checks before one transaction inserts the immutable graph and derives the authoritative Task count back from those inserted `task_contracts` rows. It passes that count with literal `GlobalBudgetMetric.TASKS`, the current Budget digest, `V01_MECHANISM_LIMITS.warning_percent`, and `global_ceiling_for(current_budget, GlobalBudgetMetric.TASKS)` to Task 9B's `_settle_global_usage_in_transaction`; no caller supplies an absolute usage or ceiling. At 10/12 it records the once-per-revision warning and transitions to `AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL`. At 12/12 it first persists and journals the Plan action, then closes dispatch, changes the Run to `PAUSED`, and appends `BUDGET_STOP_REQUESTED` immediately after `PLAN_PROPOSED` in that same transaction. Above 12 it persists no graph or usage. Invalid/overflow pause updates only Run/planning count and Audit, never a partial graph. `settle_planning_read` uses `PlanningReadResult.returned_bytes`, derived from the canonical bounded payload before persistence; its compare-and-add succeeds only if the resulting total is within the current authorization cap. On overflow it preserves the prior total, closes the just-recorded intent with an allowlisted `PLANNING_READ_LIMIT` result that contains no newly read content, records the exact paused stop in the same transaction, and returns `PlanningReadSettlement(sequence, "PLANNING_READ_LIMIT")` so `PlanningActionApplier` cannot continue dispatch.

The real Plan transaction, not a direct test call to `settle_global_usage`, produces `TASKS=10` plus its warning and `TASKS=12` plus a post-Plan stop. Together with Task 9B's six producers and Task 11B active time, this M1-07 selector is the first valid all-eight production-producer claim.

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement Authority-reserved model dispatch and the closed planning turn**

```python
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Annotated, Literal, Mapping, Protocol, Self

from pydantic import Field, TypeAdapter, ValidationError, model_validator

from apexcrew.adapters.repository.no_follow import RepositoryUnsafeError
from apexcrew.domain.limits import V01_MECHANISM_LIMITS
from apexcrew.domain.plan import CanonicalPath, PathValidationError


PLANNING_ACTION_KINDS = frozenset({"read_tracked_file", "search_tracked_content", "submit_plan", "fail"})


class AuthorityModelClient:
    """The sole Coordinator/WorkerLoop path to ModelPort in production."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: ModelPort,
        journal: ModelJournal,
        authority: Authority,
        clock: Clock,
        backoff: BackoffPort | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._model = model
        self._journal = journal
        self._authority = authority
        self._clock = clock
        self._backoff = ImmediateBackoff() if backoff is None else backoff

    def complete(
        self, first_request: ModelReservationRequest
    ) -> ModelDispatchResult | ModelReservation:
        if first_request.turn is not None or first_request.provider_attempt_number != 1:
            raise ValueError("FIRST_MODEL_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED")
        model_request = first_request.model_request
        reservation_request = first_request
        attempt_window = first_request.deadline_at_utc - first_request.started_at_utc
        for retry_index in range(V01_MECHANISM_LIMITS.provider_retry_ceiling + 1):
            reservation = self._authority.reserve_model_attempt(reservation_request)
            if reservation.decision != "RESERVED":
                return reservation
            if reservation.turn is None or reservation.intent is None:
                raise AssertionError("reserved model attempt has no turn or intent")
            settled = self._journal.settle_model_attempt(
                reservation.intent,
                self._model.complete(model_request),
                expected_sequence=self._journal.audit_sequence(model_request.run_id),
            )
            dispatch = settled.dispatch_result
            if (
                settled.kind != ProviderAttemptKind.KNOWN_CLOSED_REJECTION
                or retry_index == V01_MECHANISM_LIMITS.provider_retry_ceiling
            ):
                return dispatch
            seconds = PROVIDER_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS[retry_index]
            self._journal.record_model_backoff(
                model_request.run_id,
                reservation.intent.intent_id,
                seconds,
                expected_sequence=self._journal.audit_sequence(model_request.run_id),
            )
            self._backoff.wait(seconds)
            started_at = self._clock.now()
            task_counters = (
                None
                if first_request.owner_kind == "PLANNING"
                else self._journal.task_budget_state(
                    model_request.run_id, first_request.task_id
                )
            )
            reservation_request = replace(
                first_request,
                turn=reservation.turn,
                provider_attempt_number=retry_index + 2,
                expected_run_counters=self._journal.model_counters(model_request.run_id),
                expected_task_counters=task_counters,
                started_at_utc=started_at,
                deadline_at_utc=started_at + attempt_window,
                expected_sequence=self._journal.audit_sequence(model_request.run_id),
            )
        raise AssertionError("closed model retry loop exhausted without a result")


def planning_snapshot_digest(
    repository_id: RepositoryId, pinned_base_oid: GitOid, scope_digest: Sha256DigestText
) -> Sha256DigestText:
    return Sha256DigestText(sha256_digest(canonical_json({
        "repository_id": str(repository_id),
        "pinned_base_oid": str(pinned_base_oid),
        "scope_digest": str(scope_digest),
    })))


class PlanningTurnBinding(FrozenDocument):
    repository_id: RepositoryId
    pinned_base_oid: GitOid
    snapshot_digest: Sha256DigestText
    scope_digest: Sha256DigestText

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_snapshot_digest(self) -> Self:
        if self.snapshot_digest != planning_snapshot_digest(
            self.repository_id, self.pinned_base_oid, self.scope_digest
        ):
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_INVALID")
        return self


class PlanningAuthorization(FrozenDocument):
    run_id: RunId
    decision: Literal["ALLOW", "PAUSE"]
    reason: str | None = None
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests
    target_safety_digest: Sha256DigestText
    credential_profile: str | None
    read_authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument | None
    turn_binding: PlanningTurnBinding | None
    planning_request_count: int = Field(ge=0, le=8)
    planning_request_ceiling: int = Field(ge=1, le=8)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_decision(self) -> Self:
        if self.decision == "ALLOW":
            if (
                self.reason is not None
                or self.read_authorization is None
                or self.turn_binding is None
                or self.planning_request_count >= self.planning_request_ceiling
            ):
                raise ValueError("PLANNING_ALLOW_BINDING_INVALID")
        elif (
            not self.reason
            or self.read_authorization is not None
            or self.turn_binding is not None
        ):
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_PAUSE_BINDING_INVALID")
        return self


class PlanningReadTrackedFileAction(FrozenDocument):
    kind: Literal["read_tracked_file"] = "read_tracked_file"
    path: str


class PlanningSearchTrackedContentAction(FrozenDocument):
    kind: Literal["search_tracked_content"] = "search_tracked_content"
    query: str = Field(min_length=1)
    paths: tuple[str, ...]


class PlanningSubmitPlanAction(FrozenDocument):
    kind: Literal["submit_plan"] = "submit_plan"
    # Task 5's canonical task/check schema is parsed before graph validation.
    plan_document: Mapping[str, object]


class PlanningFailAction(FrozenDocument):
    kind: Literal["fail"] = "fail"
    reason: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4_096)


PlanningAction = Annotated[
    PlanningReadTrackedFileAction
    | PlanningSearchTrackedContentAction
    | PlanningSubmitPlanAction
    | PlanningFailAction,
    Field(discriminator="kind"),
]
PLANNING_ACTION_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(PlanningAction)


class PlanningReadIntent(FrozenDocument):
    intent_id: IntentId
    run_id: RunId
    logical_turn_id: LogicalTurnId
    action: PlanningReadTrackedFileAction | PlanningSearchTrackedContentAction
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests
    repository_id: RepositoryId
    base_oid: GitOid
    snapshot_digest: Sha256DigestText
    scope_digest: Sha256DigestText
    idempotency_key: str

    def to_effect_intent(self, recorded_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectIntent:
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return EffectIntent(
            intent_id=self.intent_id,
            run_id=self.run_id,
            kind=self.action.kind,
            idempotency_key=self.idempotency_key,
            applicable_revision_digests=self.applicable_revision_digests,
            payload_digest=sha256_digest(payload),
            normalized_payload_json=payload,
            recorded_sequence=recorded_sequence,
            action_id=self.logical_turn_id,
        )


class PlanningReadResult(FrozenDocument):
    intent_id: IntentId
    run_id: RunId
    result_class: Literal["READ_COMPLETED", "SEARCH_COMPLETED", "DENIED"]
    bounded_payload: Mapping[str, object]
    snapshot_digest: Sha256DigestText
    returned_bytes: int = Field(ge=0)

    def to_effect_result(self, settled_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectResult:
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return EffectResult(
            intent_id=self.intent_id,
            run_id=self.run_id,
            outcome="COMPLETED" if self.result_class != "DENIED" else "FAILED",
            result_class=self.result_class,
            result_digest=sha256_digest(payload),
            bounded_result_json=payload,
            settled_sequence=settled_sequence,
            snapshot_digest=self.snapshot_digest,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PlanningReadSettlement:
    sequence: AuditSequence
    stop_reason: Literal["PLANNING_READ_LIMIT"] | None = None


class PlanningReadGateway(Protocol):
    def execute(
        self, intent: PlanningReadIntent, authorization: PlanningAuthorization
    ) -> PlanningReadResult:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PlanningSnapshotReader(Protocol):
    def read_tracked_file(
        self, base_oid: GitOid, path: CanonicalPath, authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument
    ) -> tuple[str, Sha256DigestText, bool]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def search_tracked_content(
        self, base_oid: GitOid, query: str, paths: tuple[CanonicalPath, ...],
        authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument,
    ) -> tuple[Mapping[str, object], ...]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class BoundedPlanningReadGateway(PlanningReadGateway):
    def __init__(self, reader: PlanningSnapshotReader) -> None:
        self._reader = reader

    def execute(
        self, intent: PlanningReadIntent, authorization: PlanningAuthorization
    ) -> PlanningReadResult:
        if (
            authorization.decision != "ALLOW"
            or authorization.read_authorization is None
            or authorization.turn_binding is None
        ):
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_READ_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_ALLOWED")
        binding = authorization.turn_binding
        if (
            intent.run_id != authorization.run_id
            or intent.applicable_revision_digests != authorization.applicable_revision_digests
            or intent.repository_id != binding.repository_id
            or intent.base_oid != binding.pinned_base_oid
            or intent.snapshot_digest != binding.snapshot_digest
            or intent.scope_digest != binding.scope_digest
        ):
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_READ_BINDING_MISMATCH")
        try:
            if isinstance(intent.action, PlanningReadTrackedFileAction):
                content, digest, truncated = self._reader.read_tracked_file(
                    intent.base_oid, CanonicalPath.parse(intent.action.path), authorization.read_authorization,
                )
                payload: Mapping[str, object] = {
                    "path": intent.action.path, "content": content,
                    "content_digest": digest, "truncated": truncated,
                }
                result_class = "READ_COMPLETED"
            else:
                payload = {"matches": self._reader.search_tracked_content(
                    intent.base_oid, intent.action.query,
                    tuple(CanonicalPath.parse(path) for path in intent.action.paths),
                    authorization.read_authorization,
                )}
                result_class = "SEARCH_COMPLETED"
        except (PlanningReadDenied, RepositoryUnsafeError, UnicodeError):
            payload = {"reason": "PLANNING_READ_DENIED"}
            result_class = "DENIED"
        return PlanningReadResult(
            intent_id=intent.intent_id, run_id=intent.run_id,
            result_class=result_class, bounded_payload=payload,
            snapshot_digest=intent.snapshot_digest,
            returned_bytes=(
                0 if result_class == "DENIED"
                else len(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8"))
            ),
        )


# src/apexcrew/adapters/repository/git.py
class GitBytesSpawner(Protocol):
    def run_bytes(
        self, argv: tuple[str, ...], cwd: Path, environment: Mapping[str, str]
    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class SubprocessGitBytesSpawner:
    def run_bytes(
        self, argv: tuple[str, ...], cwd: Path, environment: Mapping[str, str]
    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        return subprocess.run(
            argv,
            cwd=cwd,
            env=dict(environment),
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=False,
            timeout=30,
        )


class GitCommandRunner:
    # Extend Task 7's constructor without changing its existing text `run` path.
    def __init__(
        self,
        git_executable: Path,
        trusted_empty_dir: Path,
        spawner: GitSpawner | None = None,
        binary_spawner: GitBytesSpawner | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if not git_executable.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("ABSOLUTE_GIT_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED")
        self._git = git_executable
        self._trusted_empty_dir = trusted_empty_dir
        self._spawner = SubprocessGitSpawner() if spawner is None else spawner
        self._binary_spawner = (
            SubprocessGitBytesSpawner()
            if binary_spawner is None
            else binary_spawner
        )

    def run_bytes(
        self, repository: RepositoryInstance, argv: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        repository.assert_stable()
        command = (
            str(self._git), "-c", "core.hooksPath=" + str(self._trusted_empty_dir / "hooks"),
            "-c", "commit.gpgSign=false", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false",
            "-c", "diff.external=", "-c", "credential.helper=", *argv,
        )
        return self._binary_spawner.run_bytes(
            command, repository.root, closed_git_environment(self._trusted_empty_dir)
        )


# src/apexcrew/adapters/repository/planning.py
class PlanningReadDenied(RuntimeError):
    pass


class PlanningPathGate(Protocol):
    def require_allowed(
        self, path: CanonicalPath, authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument
    ) -> None:
        """Reject secret, protected, noncanonical, or out-of-scope paths without content."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def require_manifest_allowed(
        self, path: CanonicalPath, binding: PlanningTurnBinding
    ) -> None:
        """Apply the same canonical scope and secret checks before model construction."""
        raise NotImplementedError


class PlanningManifest(FrozenDocument):
    entries: tuple[tuple[CanonicalPath, Sha256DigestText, int], ...]
    total_bytes: int = Field(ge=0)


class PlanningManifestReader(Protocol):
    def manifest(self, binding: PlanningTurnBinding) -> PlanningManifest:
        raise NotImplementedError


class GitPlanningSnapshotReader(PlanningSnapshotReader, PlanningManifestReader):
    def __init__(
        self, repository: RepositoryInstance, repository_id: RepositoryId,
        runner: GitCommandRunner,
        paths: PlanningPathGate,
    ) -> None:
        self._repository = repository
        self._repository_id = repository_id
        self._runner = runner
        self._paths = paths

    def manifest(self, binding: PlanningTurnBinding) -> PlanningManifest:
        if binding.repository_id != self._repository_id:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_MANIFEST_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH")
        result = self._runner.run_bytes(
            self._repository, ("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", str(binding.pinned_base_oid))
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_MANIFEST_TREE_UNAVAILABLE")
        entries: list[tuple[CanonicalPath, Sha256DigestText, int]] = []
        total = 0
        if len(result.stdout) > 2_000_000:
            raise PlanningContextOverflow()
        for record in _parse_ls_tree_records(result.stdout, maximum=2_000_000):
            try:
                path = CanonicalPath.parse(record.path)
            except PathValidationError as error:
                raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_MANIFEST_PATH_INVALID") from error
            if record.mode not in {b"100644", b"100755"} or record.object_type != b"blob":
                continue
            try:
                self._paths.require_manifest_allowed(path, binding)
            except PlanningReadDenied:
                # Denied names never enter the manifest, request, or persistent result.
                continue
            size = self._blob_size(GitOid(record.oid.decode("ascii", errors="strict")))
            if size < 0:
                raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_BLOB_SIZE_INVALID")
            entries.append((path, sha256_digest(record.oid.decode("ascii")), size))
            total += size
            if len(entries) > 2_000 or total > 131_072:
                raise PlanningContextOverflow()
        if tuple(path for path, _, _ in entries) != tuple(sorted(path for path, _, _ in entries)):
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_MANIFEST_ORDER_INVALID")
        return PlanningManifest(entries=tuple(entries), total_bytes=total)

    def read_tracked_file(
        self, base_oid: GitOid, path: CanonicalPath,
        authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument,
    ) -> tuple[str, Sha256DigestText, bool]:
        self._paths.require_allowed(path, authorization)
        oid = self._single_regular_blob(base_oid, path)
        raw = self._read_blob(oid, authorization.max_file_bytes)
        try:
            text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_READ_NOT_UTF8") from error
        return text, sha256_digest(raw), False

    def search_tracked_content(
        self, base_oid: GitOid, query: str, paths: tuple[CanonicalPath, ...],
        authorization: PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument,
    ) -> tuple[Mapping[str, object], ...]:
        if not paths:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_SEARCH_PATHS_EMPTY")
        needle = query.encode("utf-8")
        returned = 0
        matches: list[Mapping[str, object]] = []
        for path in sorted(paths, key=str):
            self._paths.require_allowed(path, authorization)
            raw = self._read_blob(
                self._single_regular_blob(base_oid, path), authorization.max_file_bytes
            )
            for offset in _byte_offsets(raw, needle):
                if len(matches) == authorization.max_search_matches:
                    return tuple(matches)
                if returned + len(str(path).encode("utf-8")) > authorization.max_search_bytes:
                    return tuple(matches)
                matches.append({
                    "path": str(path), "byte_offset": offset,
                    "content_digest": sha256_digest(raw),
                })
                returned += len(str(path).encode("utf-8"))
        return tuple(matches)

    def _single_regular_blob(self, base_oid: GitOid, path: CanonicalPath) -> GitOid:
        result = self._runner.run_bytes(
            self._repository, ("ls-tree", "-z", str(base_oid), "--", str(path))
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TREE_LOOKUP_FAILED")
        records = _parse_ls_tree_records(result.stdout)
        if len(records) != 1 or records[0].path != str(path):
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TRACKED_REGULAR_FILE_REQUIRED")
        record = records[0]
        if record.mode not in {b"100644", b"100755"} or record.object_type != b"blob":
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TRACKED_REGULAR_FILE_REQUIRED")
        return GitOid(record.oid.decode("ascii", errors="strict"))

    def _read_blob(self, oid: GitOid, maximum: int) -> bytes:
        byte_count = self._blob_size(oid)
        if byte_count < 0 or byte_count > maximum:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_BLOB_TOO_LARGE")
        content = self._runner.run_bytes(self._repository, ("cat-file", "blob", str(oid)))
        if content.returncode != 0 or len(content.stdout) != byte_count:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_BLOB_READ_FAILED")
        return content.stdout

    def _blob_size(self, oid: GitOid) -> int:
        size = self._runner.run_bytes(self._repository, ("cat-file", "-s", str(oid)))
        if size.returncode != 0 or not size.stdout.endswith(b"\n"):
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_BLOB_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE")
        try:
            return int(size.stdout[:-1].decode("ascii", errors="strict"))
        except ValueError as error:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_BLOB_SIZE_INVALID") from error


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LsTreeRecord:
    mode: bytes
    object_type: bytes
    oid: bytes
    path: str


def _parse_ls_tree_records(
    raw: bytes, *, maximum: int = 131_072
) -> tuple[LsTreeRecord, ...]:
    if raw == b"":
        return ()
    if len(raw) > maximum or not raw.endswith(b"\0"):
        raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TREE_OUTPUT_INVALID")
    parsed: list[LsTreeRecord] = []
    for record in raw[:-1].split(b"\0"):
        metadata, separator, encoded_path = record.partition(b"\t")
        fields = metadata.split(b" ")
        if not separator or len(fields) != 3:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TREE_OUTPUT_INVALID")
        mode, object_type, oid = fields
        try:
            path = encoded_path.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_TREE_OUTPUT_INVALID") from error
        parsed.append(LsTreeRecord(mode, object_type, oid, path))
    return tuple(parsed)


def _byte_offsets(content: bytes, needle: bytes) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    if not needle:
        raise PlanningReadDenied("PLANNING_SEARCH_QUERY_INVALID")
    offsets: list[int] = []
    start = 0
    while (offset := content.find(needle, start)) != -1:
        offsets.append(offset)
        start = offset + len(needle)
    return tuple(offsets)


class PlanningState(Protocol):

    def record_planning_read_intent(

        raise NotImplementedError


class PlanningAuthorizationProvider(Protocol):

        raise NotImplementedError


class PlanningContextOverflow(RuntimeError):
    pass


class PlanningContextBuilder(Protocol):
    def build_planning_request(
        self, run_id: RunId, authorization: PlanningAuthorization
    ) -> ModelRequest:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PlanningRequestFactory(Protocol):
    def create(
        self, *, run_id: RunId, authorization: PlanningAuthorization,
        manifest: PlanningManifest,
    ) -> ModelRequest:
        raise NotImplementedError


class BoundedPlanningContextBuilder(PlanningContextBuilder):
    def __init__(
        self, manifests: PlanningManifestReader, requests: PlanningRequestFactory
    ) -> None:
        self._manifests = manifests
        self._requests = requests

    def build_planning_request(
        self, run_id: RunId, authorization: PlanningAuthorization
    ) -> ModelRequest:
        if (
            authorization.decision != "ALLOW"
            or authorization.turn_binding is None
            or authorization.read_authorization is None
            or authorization.run_id != run_id
        ):
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_CONTEXT_AUTHORIZATION_MISMATCH")
        manifest = self._manifests.manifest(authorization.turn_binding)
        limits = authorization.read_authorization
        if (
            len(manifest.entries) > limits.max_manifest_entries
            or manifest.total_bytes > limits.max_manifest_bytes
        ):
            raise PlanningContextOverflow()
        return self._requests.create(
            run_id=run_id, authorization=authorization, manifest=manifest
        )


class Clock(Protocol):
    def now(self) -> datetime:
        raise NotImplementedError

class PlanningActionApplier:
    def __init__(
        self, state: PlanningState, reads: PlanningReadGateway, ids: PlanningIdSource
    ) -> None:
        self._state = state
        self._reads = reads
        self._ids = ids

    def apply(
        self,
        *,
        run_id: RunId,
        logical_turn_id: LogicalTurnId,
        action: Mapping[str, object],
        authorization: PlanningAuthorization,
        recovered_marker: EffectIntent | None,
        permit: RuntimePermit | None,
        expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> RuntimeDecision:
        if (recovered_marker is None) != (permit is None):
            raise ValueError("RECOVERED_MARKER_PERMIT_BINDING_MISMATCH")
        if permit is not None and permit.state != "CONSUMED":
            raise ValueError("RECOVERED_MARKER_PERMIT_NOT_CONSUMED")
        if authorization.decision != "ALLOW" or authorization.turn_binding is None:
            raise ValueError("PLANNING_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_ALLOWED")
        try:
            parsed = PLANNING_ACTION_ADAPTER.validate_python(action)
        except ValidationError:
            sequence = self._state.record_planning_failure_or_invalid_action(
                run_id, logical_turn_id, "INVALID_PLANNING_ACTION", authorization,
                recovered_marker, permit, expected_sequence,
            )
            return RuntimeDecision.invalid_planning_action(sequence)
        if isinstance(parsed, (PlanningReadTrackedFileAction, PlanningSearchTrackedContentAction)):
            intent = PlanningReadIntent(
                intent_id=self._ids.next_intent_id(run_id), run_id=run_id,
                logical_turn_id=logical_turn_id, action=parsed,
                applicable_revision_digests=authorization.applicable_revision_digests,
                repository_id=authorization.turn_binding.repository_id,
                base_oid=authorization.turn_binding.pinned_base_oid,
                snapshot_digest=authorization.turn_binding.snapshot_digest,
                scope_digest=authorization.turn_binding.scope_digest,
                idempotency_key=f"planning-read:{run_id}:{logical_turn_id}",
            )
            self._state.record_planning_read_intent(
                intent, recovered_marker, permit, expected_sequence
            )
            result = self._reads.execute(intent, authorization)
            settlement = self._state.settle_planning_read(
                intent, result, self._state.audit_sequence(run_id)
            )
            if settlement.stop_reason is not None:
                return RuntimeDecision.pause(settlement.stop_reason, settlement.sequence)
            return RuntimeDecision.continued(settlement.sequence)
        if isinstance(parsed, PlanningSubmitPlanAction):
            sequence = self._state.persist_submitted_plan(
                run_id, parsed.plan_document, authorization, logical_turn_id,
                recovered_marker, permit, expected_sequence,
            )
            return RuntimeDecision.pause("AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL", sequence)
        sequence = self._state.record_planning_failure_or_invalid_action(
            run_id, logical_turn_id, parsed.reason, authorization,
            recovered_marker, permit, expected_sequence,
        )
        return RuntimeDecision.pause("PLANNING_FAILED", sequence)


class CoordinatorService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        planning_authorization: PlanningAuthorizationProvider,
        context: PlanningContextBuilder,
        models: AuthorityModelClient,
        planning_actions: PlanningActionApplier,
        journal: ModelJournal,
        state: PlanningState,
        clock: Clock,
    ) -> None:
        self._planning_authorization = planning_authorization
        self._context = context
        self._models = models
        self._planning_actions = planning_actions
        self._journal = journal
        self._state = state
        self._clock = clock

    def run_planning_turn(self, run_id: RunId) -> RuntimeDecision:
        authorization = self._planning_authorization.current(run_id)
        if authorization.decision != "ALLOW":
            return RuntimeDecision.pause(authorization.reason)
        try:
            request = replace(
                self._context.build_planning_request(run_id, authorization),
                owner_kind="PLANNING", task_id=None, attempt_id=None, tranche_id=None,
            )
        except PlanningContextOverflow:
            sequence = self._state.return_to_draft_for_planning_context_overflow(
                run_id, authorization, self._journal.audit_sequence(run_id)
            )
            return RuntimeDecision.pause("PLANNING_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", sequence)
        started_at = self._clock.now()
        reservation_request = ModelReservationRequest(
            run_id=run_id,
            owner_kind="PLANNING",
            task_id=None,
            attempt_id=None,
            tranche_id=None,
            turn=None,
            model_request=request,
            provider_attempt_number=1,
            target_safety_digest=authorization.target_safety_digest,
            credential_profile=authorization.credential_profile,
            expected_run_counters=self._journal.model_counters(run_id),
            expected_task_counters=None,
            started_at_utc=started_at,
            deadline_at_utc=started_at + timedelta(minutes=2),
            expected_sequence=self._journal.audit_sequence(run_id),
        )
        outcome = self._models.complete(reservation_request)
        if isinstance(outcome, ModelReservation):
            return RuntimeDecision.pause(outcome.reason)
        if outcome.normalized_action is None:
            return RuntimeDecision.pause("RETURNED_MODEL_MISMATCH")
        return self._apply_planning_action(
            run_id,
            outcome.logical_turn_id,
            outcome.normalized_action,
            authorization,
            recovered_marker=None,
            permit=None,
        )

    def resume_recovered_planning_action(
        self,
        run_id: RunId,
        permit: RuntimePermit,
        action: RecoveredModelAction,
    ) -> RuntimeDecision:
        if (
            action.turn.owner_kind != "PLANNING"
            or action.turn.run_id != run_id
            or action.turn.task_id is not None
            or action.turn.attempt_id is not None
            or action.turn.tranche_id is not None
        ):
            raise ValueError("RECOVERED_PLANNING_OWNER_BINDING_MISMATCH")
        authorization = self._planning_authorization.current(run_id)
        if authorization.decision != "ALLOW":
            return RuntimeDecision.pause(authorization.reason)
        return self._apply_planning_action(
            run_id,
            action.turn.logical_turn_id,
            action.normalized_action,
            authorization,
            recovered_marker=action.effect_intent,
            permit=permit,
        )

    def _apply_planning_action(
        self,
        run_id: RunId,
        logical_turn_id: LogicalTurnId,
        action: Mapping[str, object],
        authorization: PlanningAuthorization,
        *,
        recovered_marker: EffectIntent | None,
        permit: RuntimePermit | None,
    ) -> RuntimeDecision:
        return self._planning_actions.apply(
            run_id=run_id,
            logical_turn_id=logical_turn_id,
            action=action,
            authorization=authorization,
            recovered_marker=recovered_marker,
            permit=permit,
            expected_sequence=self._journal.audit_sequence(run_id),
        )
```

`ModelJournal` is extended here with the existing Task 4A `audit_sequence`, `settle_model_attempt`, `record_model_backoff`, and `model_counters` methods plus Task 9 `task_budget_state`. `PlanningAuthorizationProvider.current(run_id)` reads one sequence-consistent Run/Policy/Budget/Model binding and returns `ALLOW` only for `PLANNING`, fewer settled planning requests than the current approved `planning_request_ceiling`, a current approved Policy with its exact `PlanningReadAuthorizationDocument`, current revision digests, target-safety digest, and one `PlanningTurnBinding`. The ceiling is copied into `PlanningAuthorization` and can be lowered/restored only through the narrow Budget revision path, never above eight. The binding carries the persisted repository ID, pinned base OID, and planning-scope digest; `planning_snapshot_digest` derives its fixed snapshot digest from precisely those canonical fields, so a later caller cannot substitute a different repository, base, or scope. It returns either a trusted configured credential-profile reference or `None` for `ScriptedMockLLM`, never a credential value. Every other case returns a closed `PAUSE` reason with no read authorization or turn binding. `PlanningActionApplier` above is the concrete, sole planning-output boundary: it accepts exactly one typed action, no array, no unknown key, no raw shell text, and no worker action kind.

For a planning read/search, `record_planning_read_intent` derives `PlanningReadIntent.to_effect_intent(expected_sequence + 1)`, rechecks the complete `PlanningTurnBinding`, records that Task 3 intent plus `PLANNING_READ_INTENT_RECORDED`, and, when present, settles the exact recovered marker in the same expected-sequence transaction before `PlanningReadGateway` can open a file. `settle_planning_read` derives `PlanningReadResult.to_effect_result`, consumes its explicit canonical `returned_bytes`, and atomically persists only an in-cap bounded feedback/result, cumulative-byte counter, and `PLANNING_READ_SETTLED`; a result that would exceed the cap returns `PlanningReadSettlement(..., "PLANNING_READ_LIMIT")`, closes the current planning turn, and retains no newly exposed content. `PlanningActionApplier` maps that settlement to the same public pause rather than issuing another planning action. It never exposes denied path content. For `submit_plan`, `persist_submitted_plan` admits only a canonical object with `tasks`, `proposed_promotion_order`, and `run_checks`; it decodes each Task through Task 5's `TaskContract.from_strings`, decodes every check through Task 5's `CheckDefinition`, calls `validate_plan`, derives sorted dependency/hazard edges, and rejects missing/extra/duplicate/unsorted entries before it inserts the immutable graph. It binds the proposal to the current Run head and all current revisions, advances the count, changes the Run to `AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL`, and, when present, settles the recovered marker in that same transaction. A `fail` or schema-invalid action records its exact logical-turn digest, count, stop/failure state, and marker settlement atomically. A recovered marker can therefore never be parsed twice, replaced, or silently skipped.

Production composition gives Coordinator and Task 16 WorkerLoop only `AuthorityModelClient`, never Task 4A's reservation-owning `DurableModelClient` or a raw `ModelPort`. Each attempt is therefore preceded by Task 9's single state/revision/target/credential/counter/intent/Audit transaction and followed by Task 4A's single reservation-settlement/counter/committed-completion/Audit transaction. A denied or paused reservation makes zero provider calls. A known-closed retry repeats the full Authority reservation with fresh counter snapshots and expected sequence; an uncertain or mismatched completion never retries. Authority alone derives `reserved_amounts` from the current approved Budget; callers never supply that field.

`PlanningContextBuilder.build_planning_request` first opens only a bounded in-scope tracked regular-file manifest from the fixed `PlanningTurnBinding`. It enforces the 2,000-entry/128-KiB manifest cap before it constructs a `ModelReservationRequest`; a manifest overflow atomically records `DRAFT/PLANNING_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW` with counters preserved, invalidates the current planning authorization, and calls neither Authority nor `ModelPort`. The read gateway enforces 128 KiB per file, 2 MiB cumulative returned content, and 200 matches/64 KiB per search. It rejects symlink, secret, ignored, untracked, protected, or out-of-scope names before returning them. A valid Plan must have at most 12 complete contracts, exact Run Check Set, current base/revision bindings, and a validated acyclic hazard graph. Persist the proposal or any invalid/eighth-turn pause with the exact Run ID, all current revision digests, and `expected_sequence`; the graph/state/counters and one Audit event commit or roll back together.

def test_crash_after_private_ref_cas_recovers_only_after_fresh_continue_permit(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    app = crash_after_private_ref_cas_application(tmp_path)
    app.control.handle(make_start_command(app.run_id))
    with pytest.raises(InjectedProcessCrash):
        app.runtime.run_until_blocked(app.run_id)
    reopened = app.reopen()
    direct = reopened.runtime.run_until_blocked(reopened.run_id)
    assert direct.reason == RunStopReason.NO_RUNTIME_PERMIT
    reopened.control.handle(
        make_continue_command(reopened, reopened.run_id, request_id="continue-private-ref")
    )
    reopened.runtime.run_until_blocked(reopened.run_id)
    assert reopened.git.cas_call_count(private_ref(reopened.run_id)) == 1

- [ ] **Step 3: Add Plan-approval and private-ref state ownership**

```sql
CREATE TABLE plan_approvals (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(run_id),
  plan_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  approval_request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  approval_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE run_refs (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
  ref_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(ref_kind IN ('PRIVATE','TARGET')),
  ref_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected_old_oid TEXT,
  current_oid TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ABSENT_EXPECTED','INIT_INTENT_RECORDED','PRESENT','CONFLICT')),
  last_intent_id TEXT REFERENCES effect_intents(intent_id),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id, ref_kind)
);
```

Both adapters implement `approve_plan`, `plan_approval`, Task 10's `issue_runtime_permit`, `record_private_ref_init_intent`, `settle_private_ref_init`, `mark_private_ref_init_indeterminate`, and `run_ref`. Plan approval verifies the immutable Task 12 graph/bindings, changes Plan/Run state to `APPROVED`/`READY_TO_START`, creates the `ABSENT_EXPECTED` private-ref row, stores the command receipt, and appends one event atomically. Control first performs the read-only start-guard inspection; only a successful inspection may issue the Task 10 `READY_TO_START` Permit in the command/receipt transaction. After Task 11 consumes that Permit, runtime revalidates the complete owner-bound guard, records the generic CAS effect intent, changes the private-ref row to `INIT_INTENT_RECORDED` and Run to `ACTIVE` in one transaction before Git. Objective CAS settlement updates `run_refs.current_oid`, `runs.run_head_oid`, effect result, and Audit in one expected-sequence transaction. Known failure pauses the now-`ACTIVE` Run; an adapter exception records durable `INDETERMINATE` before returning, while a process crash leaves the already-recorded intent for Task 24C recovery. Git remains the ref authority; this row records only the exact intended/observed binding.

```python
# src/apexcrew/domain/admission.py
import json


def private_ref(run_id: RunId) -> str:
    return f"refs/apexcrew/runs/{run_id}"


class PrivateRefCasOutcome(FrozenDocument):
    intent_id: IntentId
    run_id: RunId
    result_class: Literal["PRIVATE_REF_INITIALIZED", "PRIVATE_REF_ABSENT_FAILED", "PRIVATE_REF_CONFLICT", "PRIVATE_REF_UNOBSERVABLE"]
    observed_oid: GitOid | None

    def to_effect_result(self, settled_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectResult:
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return EffectResult(
            intent_id=self.intent_id,
            run_id=self.run_id,
            outcome={
                "PRIVATE_REF_INITIALIZED": "COMPLETED",
                "PRIVATE_REF_ABSENT_FAILED": "FAILED",
                "PRIVATE_REF_CONFLICT": "CONFLICT",
                "PRIVATE_REF_UNOBSERVABLE": "INDETERMINATE",
            }[self.result_class],
            result_class=self.result_class,
            result_digest=sha256_digest(payload),
            bounded_result_json=payload,
            settled_sequence=settled_sequence,
        )


class RefPathBinding(FrozenDocument):
    state: Literal["ABSENT", "REGULAR_FILE"]
    identity_digest: Sha256DigestText | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_state(self) -> Self:
        if (self.state == "REGULAR_FILE") != (self.identity_digest is not None):
            raise ValueError("REF_PATH_BINDING_INVALID")
        return self


class RefEffectBinding(FrozenDocument):
    repository_instance_digest: Sha256DigestText
    checkout_registration_digest: Sha256DigestText
    ref_file: RefPathBinding
    ref_lock: RefPathBinding
    reflog: RefPathBinding
    reflog_lock: RefPathBinding
    reflog_exists: bool
    reflog_message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=256)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_reflog_state(self) -> Self:
        if self.reflog_exists != (self.reflog.state == "REGULAR_FILE"):
            raise ValueError("REF_EFFECT_REFLOG_BINDING_INVALID")
        return self


class RefCasIntent(FrozenDocument):
    """The sole serialized private-init, private-promotion, and target-CAS intent."""

    intent_id: IntentId
    run_id: RunId
    kind: Literal["private_ref_init", "private_ref_cas", "target_ref_cas"]
    repository_id: RepositoryId
    ref_name: str
    expected_old_oid: GitOid | None
    prepared_oid: GitOid
    target_safety_digest: Sha256DigestText
    ref_effect_binding: RefEffectBinding
    target_reservation_id: str | None = None
    permit_generation: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)
    candidate_id: CandidateId | None = None
    grant_id: GrantId | None = None
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests
    idempotency_key: str

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_kind_binding(self) -> Self:
        if self.kind == "private_ref_init":
            valid = (
                self.ref_name == private_ref(self.run_id)
                and self.expected_old_oid is None
                and self.target_reservation_id is not None
                and self.permit_generation is not None
                and self.candidate_id is None
                and self.grant_id is None
            )
        elif self.kind == "private_ref_cas":
            valid = (
                self.ref_name == private_ref(self.run_id)
                and self.expected_old_oid is not None
                and self.target_reservation_id is None
                and self.permit_generation is None
                and self.candidate_id is not None
                and self.grant_id is None
            )
        else:
            valid = (
                self.ref_name.startswith("refs/heads/")
                and self.expected_old_oid is not None
                and self.target_reservation_id is None
                and self.permit_generation is None
                and self.candidate_id is not None
                and self.grant_id is not None
            )
        if not valid:
            raise ValueError("REF_CAS_KIND_BINDING_INVALID")
        return self

    def to_effect_intent(self, recorded_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectIntent:
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return EffectIntent(
            intent_id=self.intent_id, run_id=self.run_id, kind=self.kind,
            idempotency_key=self.idempotency_key,
            applicable_revision_digests=self.applicable_revision_digests,
            payload_digest=sha256_digest(payload), normalized_payload_json=payload,
            recorded_sequence=recorded_sequence,
            expected_prestate_json=canonical_json({
                "expected_old_oid": self.expected_old_oid,
                "ref_effect_binding": self.ref_effect_binding.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "ref_name": self.ref_name,
                "repository_id": self.repository_id,
                "target_safety_digest": self.target_safety_digest,
            }),
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_effect_intent(cls, effect: EffectIntent) -> "RefCasIntent":
        candidate = cls.model_validate_json(effect.normalized_payload_json)
        if (
            candidate.intent_id != effect.intent_id
            or candidate.run_id != effect.run_id
            or candidate.kind != effect.kind
            or candidate.idempotency_key != effect.idempotency_key
            or candidate.applicable_revision_digests != effect.applicable_revision_digests
            or candidate.to_effect_intent(effect.recorded_sequence) != effect
        ):
            raise ValueError("REF_CAS_EFFECT_INTENT_BINDING_MISMATCH")
        return candidate


class PrivateRefAdmissionPort(Protocol):
    def initialize_private_ref(self, intent: RefCasIntent) -> PrivateRefCasOutcome:
        raise NotImplementedError


class StartGuardBinding(FrozenDocument):
    run_id: RunId
    repository_id: RepositoryId
    target_reservation_id: str
    pinned_target_oid: GitOid
    target_safety_digest: Sha256DigestText
    ref_effect_binding: RefEffectBinding
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests


class RuntimeStartBinding(FrozenDocument):
    run_id: RunId
    sequence: AuditSequence
    state: Literal[RunState.READY_TO_START]
    permit_generation: int
    consumed_owner_id: RuntimeOwnerId
    consumed_sequence: AuditSequence
    guard: StartGuardBinding


class StartGuardDecision(FrozenDocument):
    ok: bool
    reason: str | None = None
    binding: StartGuardBinding | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_shape(self) -> Self:
        if self.ok != (self.reason is None and self.binding is not None):
            raise ValueError("START_GUARD_DECISION_SHAPE_INVALID")
        return self


class StartGuard(Protocol):
    def inspect(
        self, *, run_id: RunId, applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests,
        expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> StartGuardDecision:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def validate_consumed(
        self, *, binding: RuntimeStartBinding, permit: RuntimePermit,
        expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> StartGuardDecision:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PrivateRefState(Protocol):
    def runtime_start_binding(self, run_id: RunId) -> RuntimeStartBinding:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def record_private_ref_init_intent(
        self, *, binding: RuntimeStartBinding, intent: RefCasIntent,
        expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> AuditSequence:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def settle_private_ref_init(
        self, *, binding: RuntimeStartBinding, intent: RefCasIntent,
        outcome: PrivateRefCasOutcome, expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> AuditSequence:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def mark_private_ref_init_indeterminate(
        self, *, binding: RuntimeStartBinding, intent: RefCasIntent,
        failure_class: str, expected_sequence: AuditSequence,
    ) -> AuditSequence:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def audit_sequence(self, run_id: RunId) -> AuditSequence:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PrivateRefIdSource(Protocol):
    def next_intent_id(self, run_id: RunId) -> IntentId:
        raise NotImplementedError


class PrivateRefInitializer(PrivateRefDriver):
    def __init__(
        self, store: PrivateRefState, start_guard: StartGuard,
        admission: PrivateRefAdmissionPort, ids: PrivateRefIdSource,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._start_guard = start_guard
        self._admission = admission
        self._ids = ids

    def initialize(self, run_id: RunId, permit: RuntimePermit) -> RuntimeDecision:
        current = self._store.runtime_start_binding(run_id)
        guard = self._start_guard.validate_consumed(
            binding=current, permit=permit, expected_sequence=current.sequence,
        )
        if not guard.ok or guard.binding is None:
            return RuntimeDecision.pause(guard.reason or "START_GUARD_DENIED")
        intent = RefCasIntent(
            intent_id=self._ids.next_intent_id(run_id), run_id=run_id,
            kind="private_ref_init", repository_id=guard.binding.repository_id,
            ref_name=private_ref(run_id), expected_old_oid=None,
            prepared_oid=guard.binding.pinned_target_oid,
            target_safety_digest=guard.binding.target_safety_digest,
            ref_effect_binding=guard.binding.ref_effect_binding,
            target_reservation_id=guard.binding.target_reservation_id,
            permit_generation=permit.generation,
            applicable_revision_digests=guard.binding.applicable_revision_digests,
            idempotency_key=f"private-ref-init:{run_id}:{permit.generation}",
        )
        self._store.record_private_ref_init_intent(
            binding=current, intent=intent, expected_sequence=current.sequence,
        )
        try:
            outcome = self._admission.initialize_private_ref(intent)
        except RepositoryEffectUncertain:
            sequence = self._store.mark_private_ref_init_indeterminate(
                binding=current, intent=intent, failure_class="PRIVATE_REF_INIT_UNOBSERVABLE",
                expected_sequence=self._store.audit_sequence(run_id),
            )
            return RuntimeDecision.pause("INDETERMINATE", sequence)
        sequence = self._store.settle_private_ref_init(
            binding=current, intent=intent, outcome=outcome,
            expected_sequence=self._store.audit_sequence(run_id),
        )
        if outcome.result_class == "PRIVATE_REF_INITIALIZED":
            return RuntimeDecision(
                code="CONTINUE", resulting_sequence=sequence,
                phase_transition="PRIVATE_REF_INITIALIZED",
            )
        if outcome.result_class == "PRIVATE_REF_UNOBSERVABLE":
            return RuntimeDecision.pause("INDETERMINATE", sequence)
        return RuntimeDecision.pause(
            "PRIVATE_REF_CONFLICT" if outcome.result_class == "PRIVATE_REF_CONFLICT"
            else "PRIVATE_REF_INIT_FAILED",
            sequence,
        )
```

`runtime_start_binding` is one sequence-consistent read of the `READY_TO_START` Run, consumed Permit generation/owner/sequence, repository/target reservation, private-ref row, target-safety digest, closed ref-storage/reflog binding, and all current revision digests. `StartGuard.inspect` is the control-only, side-effect-free prerequisite check. `StartGuard.validate_consumed` repeats every check under the runtime's actual consumed `READY_TO_START` Permit, requiring its Run, generation, owner, consumed sequence, revision set, target safety, reserved locked worktree, absent un-checked-out private ref, and ref/reflog identities to match `RuntimeStartBinding`. `PrivateRefInitializer.initialize` is the Task 11 `PrivateRefDriver` implementation, so `RuntimePhaseDriverService.initialize_private_ref` calls it with that Permit; `CrewControl` never calls Git and merely performs `inspect` before it invokes Task 10 `issue_runtime_permit` in the same command/receipt transaction.

`record_private_ref_init_intent` derives the one shared `RefCasIntent.to_effect_intent(expected_sequence + 1)`, re-reads and verifies the complete owner-bound binding at `expected_sequence`, inserts the Task 3 intent, moves `run_refs` to `INIT_INTENT_RECORDED`, and moves the Run to `ACTIVE` with no initialized private ref in one state-plus-Audit transaction before `PrivateRefAdmissionPort` can invoke Git. It records the deterministic reflog message and every bound ref/reflog/lock identity in the intent. `settle_private_ref_init` derives `PrivateRefCasOutcome.to_effect_result`, takes the exact Run/revisions/intent, and commits the objective ref result, Run/ref state, and Audit event together. On a known absent-ref failure it leaves the ref absent and pauses `PRIVATE_REF_INIT_FAILED`; on foreign/third state it pauses `PRIVATE_REF_CONFLICT`; no branch adopts or overwrites an unexpected ref. On adapter uncertainty it calls `mark_private_ref_init_indeterminate` in the same expected-sequence state transition. A hard process crash occurs only after the durable intent and is recovered by Task 24C under a fresh `continue` Permit. `PrivateRefCasOutcome` is deliberately separate from the later Task 19 `AdmissionOutcome`; it describes only this typed ref-CAS boundary.

# src/apexcrew/domain/actions.py
from typing import Annotated, Literal

from pydantic import Field, TypeAdapter


class ReadAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["read"] = "read"
    path: str


class SearchAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["search"] = "search"
    query: str = Field(min_length=1)
    paths: tuple[str, ...]


class PatchAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["patch"] = "patch"
    path: str
    unified_diff: str = Field(min_length=1)


class CheckAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["check"] = "check"
    check_id: str = Field(min_length=1)


class RiskyAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["risky_action"] = "risky_action"
    operation: Literal["delete", "rename", "set_executable", "protected_patch"]
    path: str
    destination: str | None = None
    unified_diff: str | None = None
    executable: bool | None = None


class FinishAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["finish"] = "finish"
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4_096)


class FailAction(ActionEnvelope):
    kind: Literal["fail"] = "fail"
    reason: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4_096)


ToolActionEnvelope = Annotated[
    ReadAction | SearchAction | PatchAction | CheckAction | RiskyAction | FinishAction | FailAction,
    Field(discriminator="kind"),
]
ACTION_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(ToolActionEnvelope)
```

ToolResultCode = Literal[
    "READ_COMPLETED",
    "SEARCH_COMPLETED",
    "PATCH_APPLIED",
    "CHECK_PASSED",
    "CHECK_FAILED",
    "FINISHED",
    "FAILED",
    "DELETED",
    "RENAMED",
    "EXECUTABLE_CHANGED",
    "PROTECTED_PATCH_APPLIED",
    "SECRET_PATH_DENIED",
    "SCOPE_DENIED",
    "LEASE_SCOPE_DENIED",
    "NO_FOLLOW_PATH_DENIED",
    "APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
    "INFRASTRUCTURE_UNCERTAINTY",
    "INDETERMINATE",
]


class ToolMatch(FrozenDocument):
    path: str
    byte_offset: int = Field(ge=0)
    content_digest: Sha256DigestText


class ActionPreState(FrozenDocument):
    source_digest: Sha256DigestText | None = None
    source_mode: int | None = None
    destination_digest: Sha256DigestText | None = None
    destination_absent: bool = False
    protected_scope_digest: Sha256DigestText | None = None

    def canonical_json(self) -> str:
        return canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True))


class ToolIntent(FrozenDocument):
    intent_id: IntentId
    run_id: RunId
    owner_kind: ToolOwnerKind
    task_id: TaskId | None
    attempt_id: AttemptId | None
    action_id: str
    action: ToolActionEnvelope
    authorization_binding_digest: Sha256DigestText
    applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests
    repository_id: str
    snapshot_digest: Sha256DigestText
    scope_digest: Sha256DigestText
    dependency_fingerprint_basis: Sha256DigestText
    idempotency_key: str
    expected_prestate_json: str = "{}"
    expected_poststate_digest: Sha256DigestText | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_owner(self) -> Self:
        if self.owner_kind == "WORKER":
            if self.task_id is None or self.attempt_id is None:
                raise ValueError("WORKER_TOOL_OWNER_INCOMPLETE")
        elif self.task_id is not None or self.attempt_id is not None:
            raise ValueError("NON_WORKER_TOOL_OWNER_HAS_TASK")
        return self

    @classmethod
    def for_authorized_worker_action(
        cls,
        *,
        intent_id: IntentId,
        run_id: RunId,
        task_id: TaskId,
        attempt_id: AttemptId,
        action_id: str,
        action: ToolActionEnvelope,
        authorization_binding_digest: Sha256DigestText,
        applicable_revision_digests: ApplicableRevisionDigests,
        repository_id: str,
        snapshot_digest: Sha256DigestText,
        scope_digest: Sha256DigestText,
        dependency_fingerprint_basis: Sha256DigestText,
        idempotency_key: str,
        expected_prestate_json: str,
    ) -> "ToolIntent":
        return cls(
            intent_id=intent_id, run_id=run_id, owner_kind="WORKER",
            task_id=task_id, attempt_id=attempt_id, action_id=action_id,
            action=action, authorization_binding_digest=authorization_binding_digest,
            applicable_revision_digests=applicable_revision_digests,
            repository_id=repository_id, snapshot_digest=snapshot_digest,
            scope_digest=scope_digest,
            dependency_fingerprint_basis=dependency_fingerprint_basis,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            expected_prestate_json=expected_prestate_json,
        )

    def to_effect_intent(self, recorded_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectIntent:
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return EffectIntent(
            intent_id=self.intent_id,
            run_id=self.run_id,
            kind=self.action.kind,
            idempotency_key=self.idempotency_key,
            applicable_revision_digests=self.applicable_revision_digests,
            payload_digest=sha256_digest(payload),
            normalized_payload_json=payload,
            recorded_sequence=recorded_sequence,
            expected_prestate_json=self.expected_prestate_json,
            task_id=self.task_id,
            attempt_id=self.attempt_id,
            action_id=self.action_id,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_effect_intent(cls, effect: EffectIntent) -> "ToolIntent":
        payload = json.loads(effect.normalized_payload_json)
        intent = cls.model_validate(payload)
        if (
            intent.intent_id != effect.intent_id
            or intent.run_id != effect.run_id
            or intent.action.kind != effect.kind
            or intent.idempotency_key != effect.idempotency_key
            or intent.applicable_revision_digests != effect.applicable_revision_digests
            or intent.expected_prestate_json != effect.expected_prestate_json
            or sha256_digest(canonical_json(intent.model_dump(mode="json")))
            != effect.payload_digest
        ):
            raise ValueError("TOOL_EFFECT_INTENT_BINDING_MISMATCH")
        return intent


class ToolResult(FrozenDocument):
    code: ToolResultCode
    run_id: RunId | None = None
    intent_id: IntentId | None = None
    passed: bool | None = None
    timed_out: bool = False
    matches: tuple[ToolMatch, ...] = ()
    bounded_payload: Mapping[str, object] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    content_digest: str | None = None

    def to_effect_result(self, settled_sequence: AuditSequence) -> EffectResult:
        if self.run_id is None or self.intent_id is None:
            raise ValueError("TOOL_RESULT_OWNERSHIP_MISSING")
        payload = canonical_json(self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True))
        outcome: Literal["COMPLETED", "FAILED", "STALE", "CONFLICT", "INDETERMINATE"]
        if self.code in {"INDETERMINATE", "INFRASTRUCTURE_UNCERTAINTY"}:
            outcome = "INDETERMINATE"
        elif self.code in {"SECRET_PATH_DENIED", "SCOPE_DENIED", "LEASE_SCOPE_DENIED", "NO_FOLLOW_PATH_DENIED", "APPROVAL_REQUIRED"}:
            outcome = "FAILED"
        else:
            outcome = "COMPLETED"
        snapshot = self.bounded_payload.get("snapshot_digest")
        return EffectResult(
            intent_id=self.intent_id, run_id=self.run_id, outcome=outcome,
            result_class=self.code, result_digest=sha256_digest(payload),
            bounded_result_json=payload, settled_sequence=settled_sequence,
            snapshot_digest=None if snapshot is None else Sha256DigestText(str(snapshot)),
        )

    @classmethod
    def approval_required(cls, intent: ToolIntent) -> "ToolResult":
        return cls(
            code="APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
            run_id=intent.run_id,
            intent_id=intent.intent_id,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_timeout(
        cls, deadline: ActionDeadline, decision: TimeoutDecision
    ) -> "ToolResult":
        return cls(
            code=decision.outcome,
            run_id=deadline.run_id,
            intent_id=deadline.intent_id,
            passed=None,
            timed_out=True,
            bounded_payload=(
                {}
                if decision.retry_scope is None
                else {
                    "retry_scope": decision.retry_scope,
                    "snapshot_digest": deadline.snapshot_digest,
                }
            ),
        )

    @classmethod
    def indeterminate(
        cls, reason: str, *, run_id: RunId | None = None,
        intent_id: IntentId | None = None,
    ) -> "ToolResult":
        return cls(
            code="INDETERMINATE", run_id=run_id, intent_id=intent_id,
            bounded_payload={"reason": reason},
        )
```
